3175-5231-8207.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

728-1339-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1339-4616.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3318-3678.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-3678.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7153.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

431-4772-6441-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-4772-6441-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

215-647-850.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-647-850.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more counters on it

4050-4893-5523-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Training Grounds and removing two counters from it, returning Defiant Greatmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

1806-1887-2060-6798-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

413-891-2961.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2866-3518-4659-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-5147-5270.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

560-2034-4593-6720.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4593-6720.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

803-5853-6798.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-5853-6798.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Umbral Collar Zealot.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1021-4050-6620-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-4050-6620-6761.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {1}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-4050-6620-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

678-4826-5686-6644.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1486-1753-2872-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-2872-4875.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.
1486-1753-2872-4875.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

397-1939-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-1939-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

643-3951-5231-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-3951-5231-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

428-1694-3174-4493.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo and Irenicus's Vile Duplication.
428-1694-3174-4493.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

101-372-3603.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5696-6172.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6172.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Sunspring Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Sunspring Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1339-3188-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3188-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

364-877-1374-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Arcane Melee and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

1887-3484-5391-5921.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You have at least three energy counters.
1887-3484-5391-5921.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1409-3994-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Precursor Golem.
1409-3994-4050.description:
Activate Precursor Golem by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Precursor Golem enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Precursor Golem.
Resolve the Precursor Golem, creating two 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Golems, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

659-1288-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
659-1288-4050.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

2608-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Derevi.
Derevi does not have summoning sickness.
2608-4702.description:
Activate Derevi, putting a token copy of Derevi onto the battlefield.
The token copy is put into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token copy's enter the battlefield ability triggers, untapping Derevi.
Repeat.

262-1818-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-1818-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Healer of the Pride three times, and gaining you 2 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
